free_tier.stated: 1 TB to 100 TB of booked storage per account, up to 30 million objects per bucket
free_tier.notes: 1 TB is the minimum of the page's booked-storage control (min 1, max 100, step 1) and the 100 TB ceiling is stated in the specification block; the smallest configuration the order page offers is 1 TB

per_object_cap.stated: No largest single object is stated. The order page states a 100 TB maximum size per bucket and 30 million files per bucket; the product page states a 100 TB maximum capacity per account and up to 30 million objects per bucket. Neither page states a per-object size limit.
per_object_cap.notes: the product page states 100 TB of capacity per account and 30 million objects per bucket; the order page states a 100 TB maximum size per bucket and 30 million files per bucket; neither page states a largest-single-object figure

retention.stated: Data is kept for the paid term; on expiry the service is suspended and the associated data and content are permanently deleted after a grace period of three days.
retention.notes: the grace period runs from the end of the paid term, not from inactivity; the terms state no retention rule for data inside a running term

egress.terms: Ingress is free and unlimited; egress includes 10 TB per 1 TB of booked storage, so the included volume scales with the booking. Egress beyond that ratio has no published price.
egress.free_allowance: 10 TB per 1 TB of booked storage

tooling: any S3 SDK, rclone, s3cmd, restic
chaining: native S3 → Cloudflare in front → presigned URLs; no wrapper needed
limits_note: Prepaid, TB-based: the booked capacity is paid for whether or not it is used. 100 TB per account and 30 million objects per bucket. The product page publishes no S3 endpoint hostname, so the endpoint comes from the customer panel.

identity_cost.detail: registration takes a username, an email address and a password; ordering needs a password-protected customer account and prepayment, and the terms allow card, PayPal, SEPA, bank transfer or cryptocurrency

reliability_note: Small German host (AS203446), Equinix FRA-05/07/08. Payment methods verified on their KVM page: PayPal, credit card, Sofort, Giropay, EPS, Paysafecard, Przelewy24, Bitcoin, Litecoin, Alipay, Monero, bank transfer. Best payment friction profile of any EU host here for a non-EU buyer.
